data.title: Biology: cellular respiration
data.body:
# Biology: cellular respiration

**Equation:** C6H12O6 + 6 O2 → 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + energy (ATP)

## Stages
1. Glycolysis: cytoplasm, 2 ATP
2. Krebs cycle: mitochondrial matrix
3. Electron transport chain: inner membrane, ~34 ATP

- [x] Review diagram on p. 112
- [ ] Ask about anaerobic pathways

CREATE TABLE class_slots (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    weekday   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_min   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE courses (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name     TEXT NOT NULL,
    teacher  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    room     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    color    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#4f7cff',
    external_id TEXT
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE events (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    day       TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_min   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title     TEXT NOT NULL,
    details   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    color     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#8a8f98'
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE focus_sessions (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    started  TEXT NOT NULL,
    minutes  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    task_id  INTEGER REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    label    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE grades (
    external_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    subject     TEXT NOT NULL,
    day         TEXT NOT NULL,
    display     TEXT NOT NULL,
    value       REAL,
    component   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    period      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    notes       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    cancelled   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    course_id   INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE jobs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    color       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#0090ff',
    hourly_rate REAL,
    deductions  REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, pay_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hourly', monthly_pay REAL, mensilities INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 13, contract_start TEXT, contract_end TEXT, tax_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flat', inps REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 9.19, addizionali REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fixed_term INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, cuneo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, payday INTEGER, pays_previous_month INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, payday_since TEXT, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE journal (
    day  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE lessons (
    external_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    day         TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject     TEXT NOT NULL,
    topic       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    teacher     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    hour        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    course_id   INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE medicine_doses (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    medicine_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    day         TEXT NOT NULL,
    planned     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    taken       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    at_min      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE medicines (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name     TEXT NOT NULL,
    dose     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    times    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    weekdays TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    notes    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE note_images (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    uid   TEXT,
    mime  TEXT NOT NULL,
    data  BLOB NOT NULL
, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE notebooks (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#8a8f98'
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE notes (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Untitled',
    body      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    course_id INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    pinned    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated   TEXT NOT NULL,
    topic     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, notebook_id INTEGER REFERENCES notebooks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE register_items (
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 'absence', 'notice', 'book', 'document'
    external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    day         TEXT,
    data        TEXT NOT NULL,      -- JSON
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, external_id)
)

CREATE TABLE register_subjects (
    external_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    teachers    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE routines (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title     TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    weekdays  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0,1,2,3,4,5,6',
    color     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#f5a524'
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE school_days (day TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE settings (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE shift_patterns (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    weekday      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_min    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    break_min    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    since        TEXT,
    until        TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE shift_skips (
    job_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    day       TEXT NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, day, start_min)
)

CREATE TABLE shifts (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id        INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    day           TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_min     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_min  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    break_min     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    notes         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE sleep_logs (
    day     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    asleep  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    woke    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quality INTEGER,
    note    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE sync_flags (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE sync_inbox (
            kind TEXT NOT NULL, uid TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (kind, uid))

CREATE TABLE sync_tombstones (
            kind TEXT NOT NULL, uid TEXT NOT NULL, modified TEXT NOT NULL,
            dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (kind, uid))

CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title     TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'task',
    course_id INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    due       TEXT,
    done      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    details   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    external_id TEXT
, uid TEXT, modified TEXT, dirty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE transactions (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    day      TEXT NOT NULL,
    cents    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    income   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    note     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE water_logs (
    id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    day    TEXT NOT NULL,
    at_min INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE TRIGGER sync_class_slots_delete
                    AFTER DELETE ON class_slots WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                        UPDATE courses SET modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), dirty = 1
                        WHERE id = OLD.course_id;
                    END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_class_slots_insert

                        WHERE id = NEW.course_id;
                    END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_courses_del AFTER DELETE ON courses
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') AND OLD.uid IS NOT NULL BEGIN

                VALUES ('course', OLD.uid, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), 1);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_courses_ins AFTER INSERT ON courses
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                UPDATE courses SET uid = COALESCE(NEW.uid, CASE WHEN NEW.external_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ext:' || NEW.external_id ELSE lower(hex(randomblob(16))) END), modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),

                DELETE FROM sync_tombstones WHERE kind = 'course'

            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') AND OLD.uid IS NOT NULL BEGIN
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_tombstones (kind, uid, modified, dirty)
                VALUES ('task', OLD.uid, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), 1);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_tasks_ins AFTER INSERT ON tasks
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                UPDATE tasks SET uid = COALESCE(NEW.uid, CASE WHEN NEW.external_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ext:' || NEW.external_id ELSE lower(hex(randomblob(16))) END), modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
                    dirty = 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
                DELETE FROM sync_tombstones WHERE kind = 'task'
                    AND uid = (SELECT uid FROM tasks WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_tasks_upd AFTER UPDATE ON tasks
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                UPDATE tasks SET modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), dirty = 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_water_logs_del AFTER DELETE ON water_logs
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') AND OLD.uid IS NOT NULL BEGIN
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_tombstones (kind, uid, modified, dirty)
                VALUES ('water', OLD.uid, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), 1);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_water_logs_ins AFTER INSERT ON water_logs
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                UPDATE water_logs SET uid = COALESCE(NEW.uid, lower(hex(randomblob(16)))), modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
                    dirty = 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
                DELETE FROM sync_tombstones WHERE kind = 'water'
                    AND uid = (SELECT uid FROM water_logs WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_water_logs_upd AFTER UPDATE ON water_logs
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_flags WHERE name = 'applying') BEGIN
                UPDATE water_logs SET modified = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), dirty = 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
            END
